NFL|00-0037744|recyd.note: No injury designation and no reported change to his role as Arizona's top target; Love and Wilson are both active, so the offense is at full strength.

NFL|00-0040784|ryd.note: No injury designation found for Judkins before kickoff; Cleveland's report lists only defensive backs as questionable, and Sampson remains the change-of-pace back.

NFL|00-0036997|ryd.note: No designation and still Dallas's lead back; nothing reported changes his early-down workload.

NFL-ARI-at-DAL-1101.summary: Dallas WR George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) was limited all week and is questionable, though the head coach expects him to play; KaVontae Turpin and LB Dee Winters are out and TE Luke Schoonmaker (groin) did not practice Thursday or Friday. Arizona gets rookie RB Jeremiyah Love back from a two-game ankle absence (full practice Friday, no designation) with Jacoby Brissett at QB, while RG Jon Gaines and DL Walter Nolen are out and C Hjalte Froholdt is questionable after a Friday DNP.

NFL-ATL-at-TB-1101.summary: Tampa Bay is without WR Emeka Egbuka (foot; he cleared the concussion protocol but was ruled out) for a second straight game, which keeps Tez Johnson, Chris Godwin and Cade Otton as the main targets; RB Kenny Gainwell (hip) went DNP to limited to full and is questionable, and RT Luke Goedeke (calf) is questionable. Atlanta is again without RB Brian Robinson (hamstring), leaving Bijan Robinson a bigger share, and WR Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) is questionable after limited practice. Rain chances around 50% with gusts near 18 mph could trim passing efficiency.

NFL-CHI-at-SEA-1103.summary: Seattle plays without LT Charles Cross (ankle), likely replaced by Josh Jones, and WR Rashid Shaheed (knee); edge Uchenna Nwosu is doubtful after missing all three practices, and Zach Charbonnet is cleared for his season debut after ACL recovery with an uncertain workload. Chicago is again without RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe), leaving D'Andre Swift as the lead back, and its offensive line carries no injury designations.

NFL-IND-at-JAX-1101.summary: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is questionable after sitting out Friday; NFL Network reported early Sunday that he is expected to play, but he could be held back on snaps. The Colts get TE Tyler Warren and CB Sauce Gardner back, while WR Anthony Gould and CB Justin Walley are out and TE Drew Ogletree (did not practice Friday) is questionable. Josh Downs and Jonathan Taylor will play despite the trade talk, per Shane Steichen.

NFL-LV-at-NYJ-1101.summary: Breece Hall (quad) is questionable and a game-time decision after missing four straight games and practicing limited all week; Braelon Allen has led the backfield without him. The Jets are thin up front: OL Max Mitchell, EDGE Joseph Ossai and DT T'Vondre Sweat are out, EDGE David Bailey is doubtful and G Dylan Parham is questionable. Brock Bowers (calf, limited Wednesday) is off the final Raiders report.

NFL-MIN-at-DET-1101.summary: Both teams are close to full strength. Detroit is without S Kerby Joseph (out, limited all week) and CB Roger McCreary is questionable after being added Friday, which thins the Lions secondary. Minnesota's only designation is S Jay Ward (questionable). Aaron Jones (knee) finished the week with a full practice and joins Jordan Mason, back from IR, in a shared backfield.

NFL-NE-at-MIA-1101.summary: New England is without WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness), so Rhamondre Stevenson is the lead back and DeMario Douglas, Kyle Williams, Efton Chism III and TE Hunter Henry/Eli Raridon absorb the targets. The Patriots' offensive line is banged up, with a lineup the coach wouldn't commit to Friday and RT Morgan Moses playing through a foot injury. Miami is without RT Kadyn Proctor (concussion).

NFL-TEN-at-CIN-1101.summary: Tennessee is short-handed: RB Tyjae Spears, rookie WR Carnell Tate and P Tommy Townsend are out after missing every practice, which leaves Tony Pollard as the clear lead back. Calvin Ridley (hip) is questionable but moved from limited to a full practice Friday. Cincinnati is without S Kyle Dugger, with LB Joe Giles-Harris questionable; Ja'Marr Chase had only a rest day.

SOCCER-day.summary: Current team news was thin for most of today's matches. The one clear signal is Arsenal at Anfield without Saka, with Rice, Madueke and Calafiori 75%, so Arsenal -1.5 gets caution. Nobody in the player list is reported out.

fix.summary: All seven research calls hold up. Corrections: Henderson is out with an illness, not an injury; Seattle's Jadarian Price may also return; the Nwosu fact points to Derick Hall over, not the app's under. Only Andrews' yards line differs (25 vs 28.5).

NBA-OKC-at-HOU-1101.summary: OKC arrives badly short-handed (Jalen Williams, Wallace, Holmgren, Caruso, Topic, Sorber all out), putting more on Gilgeous-Alexander, Mitchell, McCain and Hartenstein. Houston is on the second night of a back-to-back after its first loss, with Sengun and Sheppard (both back) having sat Friday and Adams out; Houston's Saturday report was not yet filed.

NFL-CLE-at-PIT-1101.summary: Rico Dowdle practiced fully Thursday coming back from a toe injury, but Mike McCarthy said Jaylen Warren's role will not change. Pittsburgh is thin at receiver (Pittman on IR, Wilson and Skowronek out per the beat report), which may push more work to the tight ends; Pittsburgh is also without corners Slaughter and Echols.

NFL-PHI-at-WAS-1102.summary: Tanner McKee starts again with Jalen Hurts on injured reserve (blood clot), and the Eagles are without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, plus RB Dameon Pierce (IR). Saquon Barkley missed two practices before a limited Friday but is set to play. Washington is missing DTs Daron Payne and Javon Kinlaw, has Terry McLaurin on IR, and TE John Bates and WR Treylon Burks did not practice.

NFL-BAL-at-BUF-1101.summary: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practiced fully Wednesday and Thursday and is trending toward returning after missing three games, during which Baltimore went 1-2 and was shut out after halftime in its last two losses. Buffalo comes off a bye with DJ Moore (shoulder) and Dalton Kincaid (chest) limited, RT Spencer Brown (back) out of practice both days, and backup RB Ray Davis sick Thursday.

NFL-KC-at-DEN-1101.summary: Kansas City's pass catchers are uncertain: Travis Kelce (ankle) went from full Wednesday to limited Thursday and Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited again. Patrick Mahomes (knee) practiced fully both days. Kenneth Walker's receptions line has fallen from 3.5 to 2.5 with no explaining news found. Denver WR Jaylen Waddle (chest) and RB RJ Harvey (knee) were limited.
